chunks: And through his chain of narration, from Ali (peace be upon him), who said: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said:
The best wealth and treasure of a man is charity.
ai.seo_question: What is considered the best wealth or treasure for a person in Islamic tradition?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) identifies charity as the ultimate reserve and true wealth of a person, emphasizing its enduring spiritual value over transient material possessions. This concept aligns with Shia scholarly interpretations that view sadaqah not merely as a financial transaction but as a means of purifying the soul and securing divine favor, a theme further elaborated by Imam al-Rida (AS) in his discourses on the virtues of giving.
